Why buy a digital vignette for Austria online via the ADAC toll portal?
Immediate start of validity
The digital vignette is valid immediately upon purchase (if desired).
No service and processing fees
You only pay the vignette price and no service fees.
No delays or interruptions
No queuing and time wasted at petrol stations and toll stations.
Authorised online sales partner
The ADAC is an authorised online sales partner of ASFINAG.
Buy 1-Day and 10-Day vignettes for Austria online
10-Day Vignette Austria
The digital 10-Day Vignette with immediate validity allows you to drive on toll-compulsory motorways and speedways in Austria. The validity period of the 10-day Vignette begins on the 1st day of validity plus 9 additional calendar days. The 10-day Vignette costs € 12.80 for cars (incl. trailers) and € 5.10 for motorbikes.
Buy a 10-Day vignette for Austria online
1-Day Vignette Austria
A new vignette is now available in Austria: the digital 1-Day vignette (Daily vignette). It is valid for one calendar day from 00:00 a.m. - 11:59 p.m.. The 1-Day Vignette is available in the ADAC toll portal. The cost for a 1-Day Vignette for cars and motor vehicles up to and including 3.5 tonnes is €9.10 and €3.80 for motorcycles.
Buy a 1-Day vignette online
Long-Term Vignettes for Austria
2-Month Vignette for Austria
With the 2-Month Vignette, you can drive on toll motorways and speedways in Austria for two months from the start of validity. The 2-month vignette for cars costs €32.00 (motorbike €12.80).
Buy 2-Month Vignette for Austria *
* Only available as an adhesive vignette at adac-shop.de
Annual / Yearly Vignette for Austria
With the annual vignette, you can drive on toll motorways and speedways in Austria for up to 14 months. It is always valid from 1 December of the previous year until 31 January, 11:59 p.m. of the following year. For a car, the annual vignette costs €106.80 (motorbike €42.70).
Buy Annual Vignette for Austria *
* Only available as an adhesive vignette at adac-shop.de

Frequently asked questions regarding buying a digital vignette for Austria (FAQs)
Where can I buy a digital vignette for Austria online?
The 1-Day vignette and the 10-Day vignette can be purchased online via the ADAC toll portal. The vignette purchased via the toll portal is valid immediately, if desired. In addition, no service fees are charged for online purchases. Moreover to the digital vignette, the digital section toll for the A13 Brenner, A10 Tauern, S16 Arlberg, A9 Pyhrn and A11 Karawanken toll segments can also be purchased online in the toll portal.
->
Buy digital vignettes and section toll for Austria
How does the online purchase of the digital vignette and section toll in the ADAC toll portal work?
In just a few steps, you can buy a digital vignette or section toll for Austria in the ADAC toll portal. No registration needed.
How does it work? Here is a brief summary of the individual steps of the booking process:
Step 1: Select your vehicle (car or motorbike).
Step 2: Select your product, either vignette or section toll. If you select a section toll, please select the route(s) for which you require a digital section toll ticket.
Step 3: If you select Vignette, select the validity period (immediate start or at a later date). In the case of a section toll, validity generally begins immediately upon purchase.
Step 4: Enter your vehicle license plate number.
Step 5: Select the payment method and enter your personal details or e-mail address.
Step 6: A final check of the order overview and then click on Book with obligation to pay.
Following your booking, you will receive an order confirmation and an invoice by email.
How does the digital vignette work and how is it checked?
When ordering a digital vignette on the ADAC toll portal, enter the vehicle type, desired validity period or start date and your vehicle license plate number. If desired, the digital vignette can become valid immediately upon completion of the purchase.
Automatic vignette control cameras installed on motorway bridges and the service and control service of the Austrian toll operator ASFINAG randomly check whether a vignette has been registered for the respective license plate number/vehicle.
IMPORTANT:
Please check that you have entered your license plate number correctly when ordering, otherwise your digital vignette will not be valid and you will have to pay a fine.
If you are unsure or you did not receive a booking/order confirmation, please use the validity check of the Austrian toll operator ASFINAG to check whether a valid vignette or section toll exists for your license plate number.
-> ASFINAG Validity Check
Is my digital vignette valid immediately?
The new 1-Day and the 10-Day Vignette purchased via the ADAC toll portal have no waiting period and are therefore valid immediately. Of course, the start of validity can also be set for a later date in the future if desired.
How much is the fine (substitute toll) for a missing vignette?
If you use the motorways and speedways in Austria without a valid vignette, you will have to pay a fine (so-called substitute toll) of €120.00 (car) or €100.00 (motorbike). Anyone who is unable to pay this fine immediately must expect to be reported to the police and fined 3000 €.
To be on the safe side ...
Buy a digital vignette and section toll now
Are there motorway sections in Austria that are exempt from the vignette requirementl?
Yes, the following motorway segments are exempt from the vignette requirement:
the A 1 West motorway toll section between the state border at Walserberg and the Salzburg Nord junction,
the A 12 Inntal motorway toll section between the state border at Kufstein and the Kufstein-Süd junction,
the A 14 Rheintal/Walgau motorway toll section between the state border at Hörbranz and the Hohenems junction and
the A 26 Linz motorway toll section (
currently still under construction
)
How can I change the license plate number for my digital 10-Day Vignette?
You can change the license plate number for which you have purchased the digital 10-day vignette free of charge as long as the validity of the vignette has not yet begun.
You can make a change yourself via our order management area. Please have the order number and the e-mail address you used when ordering ready.
How can I change the validity period of my digital vignette?
You can change the validity period of your digital 10-Day Vignette free of charge as long as the validity of the vignette has not yet begun. You can either bring forward or postpone the validity period compared to the original start of validity.
Changes of the validity period can be made by yourself via our Manage Order area. Please have the order number and the e-mail address you used when ordering ready.
Do I need an additional vignette for car trailers or caravans?
For cars carrying a trailer or caravan, only the total weight of the car as a towing vehicle is relevant for determining the vignette. If this does not exceed the permissible total weight of 3.5 tonnes, only one vignette is required, namely the one for the car.
In the case of motorbikes with a sidecar, the sidecar counts as a trailer and is therefore not subject to a vignette.
